ngaap.guidance: 2025 guidance (30-Oct-2025): Revenue ~$22B (prior ~$21.75B); adjusted segment operating margin high 15% (prior mid - high 15%); Non-GAAP diluted EPS $10.50 - $10.70 (prior $10.40 - $10.60); adjusted free cash flow ~$2.65B. Segments: CS ~$5,700M (prior $5,600 - $5,700M), ~25%; IMS ~$6,500M (prior ~$6,400M), low - mid 12% (prior ~12%); SAS ~$7,100M, low 12%; AR $2,800 - $2,900M (prior ~$2,800M), mid 12%. Other: FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~$15M; non-service FAS pension income ~$285M; net interest expense ~$600M; effective tax rate on non-GAAP income 13.5% - 14.5%; weighted-average diluted shares ~188M; capital expenditures ~2% of revenue. Guidance does not assume impacts from a further prolonged government shutdown.
ngaap.notes: From Q1-25 Non-GAAP diluted EPS no longer adds back amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (2024 comparatives recast: the amortization add-back and its tax effect removed); it = diluted EPS + merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses + business divestiture-related losses (gains) / impairment of goodwill and other assets + LHX NeXt implementation costs (+ accrued corporate charge in Q4-25) + "income taxes on above adjustments and other, net". Pension adjusted non-GAAP diluted EPS = non-GAAP diluted EPS less the after-tax per-share FAS/CAS operating adjustment and non-service FAS pension income. Adjusted segment operating income = operating income excluding all unallocated corporate items (incl. amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, corporate department expense, FAS/CAS operating adjustment and the significant items) and, from Q4-25, segment impairment of goodwill and other assets; i.e. the sum of segment operating income (+ segment impairments). Effective tax rate on non-GAAP income excludes the amortization add-back from 2025 (2024 comparatives recast: e.g. Q1-24 5.5% vs 13.1% originally). Free cash flow = operating cash flow - capital expenditures + proceeds from disposal of PP&E; adjusted free cash flow adds cash used for merger, acquisition and severance. Organic revenue excludes completed divestitures (antenna May-2024, AOT Jan-2025, CAS Mar-2025). Quarter free cash flow bridge recorded; year to date: 1,144 / (266) / 9 / 887 / 64 / 951. Tax on the adjusting items nets to an $11M reduction (105 GAAP vs 94 non-GAAP; divestiture-related tax (32)).
